title: Local Kind validation for node workloads
objective: Create an ephemeral local Kubernetes environment to validate the static workload boundary before any AWS activity.

include: Pod Security, RBAC, and NetworkPolicy checks

acceptance: The cluster is named and retained only for the user's local learning session; delete it on request
AWS-specific storage is not emulated or modified in source manifests
Evidence distinguishes admission/static checks from real EKS behavior
